title: Pass Optional Kit Stores Through Sketchpad
description: Optionally pass temporary, folder, file, and remote kit store factories through Sketchpad and update the home screen so filter/create actions depend on which stores Sketchpad received.
summary: Wired optional kit store factories through all consumer entrypoints. play/index.tsx passes temporaryKitStoreFactory (InMemoryKitStore). vscode/webview.tsx passes fileKitStoreFactory (JsonFileKitStore via postMessage). desktop/renderer.tsx passes folderKitStoreFactory (FolderKitStore via Electron IPC folder selection). sketchpad/index.tsx passes temporaryKitStoreFactory (standalone) or fileKitStoreFactory (VS Code mode). Fixed missing InMemoryKitStore import in Sketchpad.tsx. Home screen already conditionally shows filter/create buttons based on availableKitKinds(). Added 14 new vitest tests covering availableKitKinds logic (9 tests) and createKit factory dispatch (5 tests). All 79 tests pass.
